title: 第455章 储力戒第454章 战任无天
slug: 分手后我聘上女同学妈妈小司机
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：分手后，我聘上女同学妈妈小司机第一卷：默认第455章储力戒（..la）一刹，天雷轰的一声砸在光盾之上。
看似坚固的光盾连一秒都没能撑住，瞬间炸裂破碎，化作点点灵力消散。
霸道的天雷毫无阻碍，径直狠狠击中任无天的身躯。
“啊……”任无天当即发出一阵凄厉至极的惨叫，整个人被天雷裹挟的巨大冲击力狠狠轰飞出去，撞向后方山壁。
轰隆一声闷响，坚硬厚实的石壁被狠狠撞出一个巨大的窟窿。
碎石飞溅、烟尘四起，任无天整个人直接卡在石壁的凹陷之中，动弹不得。
陈阳抬手收势，停下功法，周身涌动的灵力尽数收回体内。
短短数息之间，山间肆虐的狂风渐渐平息，上空厚重的乌云缓缓褪去，游走的电光、轰鸣的雷声尽数消散。
夜空重新恢复澄澈平静，繁星再次显露。
陈阳身形一闪，化作一道残影，瞬间出现在石壁的窟窿前方，垂眸看向卡在凹陷里的任无天。
此刻的任无天浑身皮肤焦黑开裂，衣衫破烂不堪，身上遍布深浅不一的伤口，血肉模糊，气息微弱到极致，奄奄一息，仅仅只剩下最后一口气吊着。
他浑身不受控制地剧烈颤抖，艰难抬起头，看向身前的陈阳，用虚弱沙哑的声音问：“你……你是什么修为？”
陈阳语气平淡，如实回道：“二级武神。”
这四个字如同惊雷，炸在任无天心头。
他脸上写满了极致的恐惧与不敢置信，死死盯着陈阳，眼底满是悔恨与绝望。
他强撑着残破的身躯，拼命挣扎着想要跪下求饶，身躯不停抖动，颤抖着开口：“武神大人……是是我有眼无珠，愚昧无知，贸然冲撞了您！
求您手下留情，给我一条活路，放我一马，我再也不会追究之前的任何事情，从此绝不与您为敌！”
陈阳眼神冰冷，不带一丝波澜：“太迟了。”
话音落下，他掌心灵力一动，凝聚出一只漆黑凛冽的灵力鬼手。
鬼手往前探出，一把牢牢抓住任无天的身躯，将他从石壁窟窿中强行拖拽出来，悬在半空。

紧接着，吸力神功运转，强悍的吞噬之力笼罩任无天，开始不断抽取他体内残存的灵力与修为根基。
任无天被悬在半空，浑身剧痛难忍，当即拼命挣扎扭动，却根本挣脱不开鬼手的禁锢，只能任由自身修为不断流失。
“啊啊不……”他接连发出痛苦凄厉的惨叫，慌忙不停求饶：“大人饶命！我真的知道错了！”
一旁的青霞，此时正亲眼目睹任无天长老被陈阳的鬼手死死禁锢、疯狂抽取修为的惨烈一幕。
她吓得浑身发软，双腿脱力，最终控制不住地直接瘫坐在冰冷的地面上。
她脸色惨白如纸，浑身止不住发抖。
极致的恐惧笼罩全身，让她大脑一片空白，但短短几秒的慌乱过后，她强行逼自己冷静下来，心头猛然惊醒。
她心底焦急暗道：不行，我不能待在这里，必须立刻逃走，否则下场一定会和二长老一样。
想到这里，青霞咬紧牙关，强撑着浑身发软、酸软无力的身体，手脚并用地从地上狼狈爬起，不敢回头多看一眼，转身拔腿就跑。
慌乱跑出数步，身体稍稍缓过一丝力气，她不敢有丝毫拖沓，立刻催动自身灵力施展轻功，身形一晃，朝着远处山林全速逃离，只想尽快远离这个恐怖的地方。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: After breaking up, I hired a female classmate’s mother as a driver. Volume 1: Default Chapter 455 Energy Reserve Ring (..la) In an instant, thunder struck the light shield with a loud bang.
The seemingly solid light shield couldn't hold on for even a second. It exploded and shattered in an instant, turning into little bits of spiritual power and dissipating.
The overbearing thunder struck Ren Wutian's body without any hindrance.
"Ah..." Ren Wutian immediately let out a shrill scream, and his whole body was violently blasted away by the huge impact of the thunder, crashing into the mountain wall behind him.
There was a muffled roar, and a huge hole was violently knocked out of the hard and thick stone wall.
Rubbles were flying and smoke and dust were flying everywhere. Ren Wutian was stuck directly in the depression of the stone wall, unable to move.
Chen Yang raised his hand to stop the movement, stopped the exercise, and took back all the spiritual energy surging around his body.
In just a few breaths, the raging wind in the mountains gradually subsided, the thick dark clouds in the sky slowly faded away, and the wandering lightning and roaring thunder dissipated.
The night sky became clear and calm again, and the stars appeared again.
Chen Yang's figure flashed and turned into an afterimage, instantly appearing in front of the hole in the stone wall. He lowered his eyes and looked at Ren Wutian who was stuck in the depression.
At this moment, Ren Wutian's skin was charred and cracked, his clothes were in tatters, his body was covered with wounds of varying depths, his flesh and blood were blurred, his breath was extremely weak, and he was dying, with only his last breath left to hang on.
His whole body was shaking violently uncontrollably, and he raised his head with difficulty, looked at Chen Yang in front of him, and asked in a weak and hoarse voice: "You... what is your cultivation level?"
Chen Yang spoke calmly and replied truthfully: "Second level Martial God."
These four words were like thunder, exploding in Ren Wutian's heart.
His face was filled with extreme fear and disbelief, and he stared at Chen Yang, his eyes full of regret and despair.
He held on to his broken body and struggled desperately to kneel down and beg for mercy. His body kept shaking and he spoke tremblingly: "Lord God of War... I was blind, ignorant, and rushed into you rashly!
Please be merciful, give me a way to survive, and let me go. I will never pursue anything that happened before, and I will never be your enemy from now on! "
Chen Yang's eyes were cold and without any emotion: "It's too late."
As he finished speaking, he moved his spiritual power in his palm, condensing a dark and cold spiritual ghost hand.
The ghost hand reached forward, grabbed Ren Wutian's body firmly, and dragged him out of the cave in the stone wall, hanging him in mid-air.
Immediately afterwards, the suction power was activated, and the powerful devouring force enveloped Ren Wutian, and began to continuously extract the remaining spiritual power and cultivation foundation from his body.
Ren Wutian was suspended in the air, feeling unbearable pain all over his body. He immediately struggled and twisted desperately, but he could not break free from the prison of the ghost's hand, and could only let his cultivation level continue to drain away.
"Ah no..." He let out painful and shrill screams one after another, and hurriedly begged for mercy: "Sir, please forgive me! I really know I was wrong!"
Qingxia on the side was witnessing with her own eyes the tragic scene of Elder Ren Wutian being tightly imprisoned by Chen Yang's ghost hands and frantically draining his cultivation.
She was so frightened that her whole body became weak, her legs lost strength, and she finally couldn't control herself and collapsed directly on the cold ground.
Her face was as pale as paper, and her whole body was shaking uncontrollably.
Extreme fear enveloped her whole body, leaving her mind blank, but after just a few seconds of panic, she forced herself to calm down, and her heart suddenly woke up.
She said anxiously in her heart: No, I can't stay here, I must escape immediately, otherwise I will end up like the second elder.
Thinking of this, Qingxia gritted her teeth, forced herself to hold on to her limp and weak body, and climbed up from the ground on her hands and feet. She didn't dare to look back for a second, turned around and ran away.
She ran for a few steps in a panic. After her body regained some strength, she did not dare to delay at all. She immediately mobilized her spiritual power to perform Qing Gong. She swayed and fled towards the distant mountains and forests at full speed. She just wanted to get away from this fear as soon as possible.A scary place.
